key: ELENA: You know, I usually do some monologue about the beauty of birds in the night sky before I face a challenger.
en: ELENA: You know, I usually do some monologue about the beauty of birds in the night sky before I face a challenger.
ja: エレナ: 普段は挑戦者と対決する前に、夜空を舞う鳥の美しさについて独り言を語るんだけどね。

key: But you've probably heard that before, so I guess all I have to say is...
en: But you've probably heard that before, so I guess all I have to say is...
ja: でも、たぶんもう聞いたことあるだろうから、言うことはこれだけ…

key: Prepare to be stomped so hard, your friend won't be able to tell you apart from my Ghost Types!
en: Prepare to be stomped so hard, your friend won't be able to tell you apart from my Ghost Types!
ja: 覚悟しなさい、あんまりたたきのめされて、お友達もあたしのゴーストタイプと見分けがつかなくなるくらいにね!

key: I expected nothing less from you.
en: I expected nothing less from you.
ja: あなたなら当然だと思ってたわ。

key: ELENA: Whew. That was exhausting.
en: ELENA: Whew. That was exhausting.
ja: エレナ: ふう。疲れたわ。

key: I see why you're Champion.
en: I see why you're Champion.
ja: あなたがチャンピオンなのも納得。

key: I mean, I knew I couldn't win.
en: I mean, I knew I couldn't win.
ja: まあ、勝てないってわかってたけど。

key: If you're the Champion in the future, that means you beat whoever was the Champion before you.
en: If you're the Champion in the future, that means you beat whoever was the Champion before you.
ja: 未来でチャンピオンだってことは、前のチャンピオンを倒したってことよね。

key: And you don't have to say anything, I think both of us know exactly who that was.
en: And you don't have to say anything, I think both of us know exactly who that was.
ja: 何も言わなくていいわ、それが誰だったか、二人ともよくわかってると思うし。

key: I mean, I only caught him that Zubat and taught him how to battle a week ago, and they're already talking about offering him a Gym Leader job!
en: I mean, I only caught him that Zubat and taught him how to battle a week ago, and they're already talking about offering him a Gym Leader job!
ja: だって、ズバットを捕まえてバトルの仕方を教えたのなんてほんの一週間前なのに、もうジムリーダーの仕事を打診されてるって話してるのよ!

key: Some people are so brilliant, they take to battling like a fish to water.
en: Some people are so brilliant, they take to battling like a fish to water.
ja: 生まれつきバトルの才能がある人って、まるで魚が水を得るみたいにすんなりなじむのよね。

key: Clearly you're like that, but so's my husband.
en: Clearly you're like that, but so's my husband.
ja: あなたも明らかにそのタイプだけど、うちの夫もそうなの。

key: And he has such passion and excitement for it, too.
en: And he has such passion and excitement for it, too.
ja: それに、彼はすごい情熱と興奮を持ってバトルに取り組んでるの。

key: I mean, when he evolved his Golbat, that's the happiest I've seen him since our wedding day!
en: I mean, when he evolved his Golbat, that's the happiest I've seen him since our wedding day!
ja: ゴルバットを進化させた時なんて、結婚式の日以来一番うれしそうな顔してたわよ!

key: I've never been more sure of anything in my life--
en: I've never been more sure of anything in my life--
ja: こんなに確信を持ったことは人生で他になくて――

key: Before long, Corey will be Champion.
en: Before long, Corey will be Champion.
ja: そう遠くないうちに、コーリーがチャンピオンになるはず。

key: But listen to me go on.
en: But listen to me go on.
ja: って、いつまでしゃべってるのよ、あたし。

key: The Pokémon back there is jumping around, full of energy-- probably means it's time for you to go home.
en: The Pokémon back there is jumping around, full of energy-- probably means it's time for you to go home.
ja: 後ろのポケモン、元気いっぱいで跳ね回ってるわね――そろそろ帰る時間ってことなんでしょう。

key: Safe travels! And watch your back!
en: Safe travels! And watch your back!
ja: 気をつけて! 背後にも気をつけて!

key: I'm sure my husband will come to claim the Champion title back from you in no time.
en: I'm sure my husband will come to claim the Champion title back from you in no time.
ja: きっと夫が、あっという間にあなたからチャンピオンの座を取り戻しに来るわ。

key: ELENA: I'll see you in 15 years.
en: ELENA: I'll see you in 15 years.
ja: エレナ: 15年後に会いましょう。

key: I'll be sure to come up with something real cryptic to say about recognizing you!
en: I'll be sure to come up with something real cryptic to say about recognizing you!
ja: あなたに気づいたふうを装って、意味深なことを言ってみせるから!

key: I've always wanted to do that.
en: I've always wanted to do that.
ja: ずっとやってみたかったのよね、それ。

key: TAKA: She's so full of life, too...
en: TAKA: She's so full of life, too...
ja: タカ: すごく生き生きしてるな…

key: And in the blink of an eye...
en: And in the blink of an eye...
ja: それなのに、あっという間に…

key: Not even five years from now...
en: Not even five years from now...
ja: 5年も経たないうちに…

key: ELIAS: I always insisted she and I weren't friends.
en: ELIAS: I always insisted she and I weren't friends.
ja: イライアス: 私は常々、彼女と私は友人ではないと主張してきました。

key: But... perhaps we were.
en: But... perhaps we were.
ja: ですが…もしかしたら、そうだったのかもしれません。

key: I can't say for sure.
en: I can't say for sure.
ja: 確かなことは言えませんが。

key: ...I wish she was still around so we could be.
en: ...I wish she was still around so we could be.
ja: …彼女がまだいてくれたら、そうなれたのかもしれないと思うと。

key: TAKA: Corey...
en: TAKA: Corey...
ja: タカ: コーリー…

key: ELIAS: She makes Corey sound so...
en: ELIAS: She makes Corey sound so...
ja: イライアス: 彼女の話を聞くと、コーリーがまるで…

key: Perhaps I should have accepted her invitations to dinner.
en: Perhaps I should have accepted her invitations to dinner.
ja: 夕食の誘いを受けておくべきだったのかもしれません。

key: Maybe if I had gotten to know him...
en: Maybe if I had gotten to know him...
ja: 彼のことをもっと知っていれば…

key: If he had a friend after she passed...
en: If he had a friend after she passed...
ja: 彼女が亡くなった後、彼に友人がいたなら…

key: Celebi appears to be excited to watch you battle!
en: Celebi appears to be excited to watch you battle!
ja: セレビィはあなたのバトルを見て興奮しているようだ!

key: Celebi seems full of energy and ready to go!
en: Celebi seems full of energy and ready to go!
ja: セレビィは元気いっぱいで、準備万端のようだ!

key: Do you want to travel through time again?
en: Do you want to travel through time again?
ja: もう一度時を渡る?

key: You once again feel your surroundings fade away around you as Celebi brings you forward through time!
en: You once again feel your surroundings fade away around you as Celebi brings you forward through time!
ja: セレビィがあなたを時の中へ運び、再び周囲の景色が薄れていくのを感じる!

key: Celebi looks a little impatient, but will wait for you.
en: Celebi looks a little impatient, but will wait for you.
ja: セレビィは少しじれったそうだが、待ってくれそうだ。

key: TAKA: Phoenix...
en: TAKA: Phoenix...
ja: タカ: フェニックス…

key: That was his name, y'know.
en: That was his name, y'know.
ja: それが父さんの名前だったんだ。

key: Father, I mean.
en: Father, I mean.
ja: つまり、父さんの。

key: Solaris was just a codename for all the Meteor stuff...
en: Solaris was just a codename for all the Meteor stuff...
ja: ソラリスは、メテオ絡みのただのコードネームで…

key: TAKA: W-wait, This is so high up! Where even are we!?
en: TAKA: W-wait, This is so high up! Where even are we!?
ja: タカ: ちょ、待って、すごい高さだ! ここ一体どこだよ!?

key: TAKA: Oh, wait. Celebi can only take us through time, not space.
en: TAKA: Oh, wait. Celebi can only take us through time, not space.
ja: タカ: あ、そうか。セレビィは時間しか渡れなくて、空間は渡れないんだった。

key: So if we're after the League was built, I guess this is one of the Elite Four rooms?
en: So if we're after the League was built, I guess this is one of the Elite Four rooms?
ja: リーグが建てられた後だとしたら、ここは四天王の部屋の一つってことか?

key: ...Must be Heather's, I guess.
en: ...Must be Heather's, I guess.
ja: …たぶんヘザーの部屋だな。

key: Do you think she's here?
en: Do you think she's here?
ja: 彼女、いると思う?

key: HEATHER?: Wait, fuck, nobody told me we had challengers today!
en: HEATHER?: Wait, fuck, nobody told me we had challengers today!
ja: ヘザー?: ちょ、くそ、今日挑戦者が来るなんて誰も教えてくれなかったんだけど!

key: I didn't even have time to prepare a dramatic entrance...
en: I didn't even have time to prepare a dramatic entrance...
ja: 劇的な登場を準備する時間すらなかったのに…

key: Oh well, this will probably work.
en: Oh well, this will probably work.
ja: まあいいや、これで何とかなるでしょ。

key: NOT HEATHER: ...Well shit, I actually made the jump.
en: NOT HEATHER: ...Well shit, I actually made the jump.
ja: ヘザーじゃない: …あら、まさか本当に飛び移れるとはね。

key: Usually I have to scramble to send out a Pokémon to catch me before I plummet to my death.
en: Usually I have to scramble to send out a Pokémon to catch me before I plummet to my death.
ja: 普段は落下死する前に慌ててポケモンを出して受け止めてもらわなきゃいけないのに。

key: Hello!
en: Hello!
ja: こんにちは!

key: I am Elena Molinar, Elite Four Extraordinaire! And--
en: I am Elena Molinar, Elite Four Extraordinaire!  And--
ja: 私はエレナ・モリナー、並外れた四天王よ! そして――

key: ELENA: ...Wait, if that funky onion is a seventh Pokémon, we don't allow that.
en: ELENA: ...Wait, if that funky onion is a seventh Pokémon, we don't allow that.
ja: エレナ: …待って、その変な玉ねぎが7匹目のポケモンだっていうなら、それは認められないわよ。

key: And we certainly don't allow spectators.
en: And we certainly don't allow spectators.
ja: それに、見物人だって絶対に認めない。

key: Who let two of you in here?
en: Who let two of you in here?
ja: 誰があんたたち二人をここに入れたわけ?

key: TAKA: ...Oh.
en: TAKA: ...Oh.
ja: タカ: …あ。

key: We're still in the past; this is...
en: We're still in the past; this is...
ja: まだ過去にいるんだ。これは…

key: ELENA: Speak up, I can't hear a word you're saying!
en: ELENA: Speak up, I can't hear a word you're saying!
ja: エレナ: もっと大きな声で、何言ってるか全然聞こえない!

key: It's super windy up here-- almost like that's a key part of how I battle or something!
en: It's super windy up here-- almost like that's a key part of how I battle or something!
ja: ここ、ものすごい風でね――まるであたしのバトルスタイルの重要な要素だとでも言うみたいに!

key: TAKA: Ah, right, well, uh...
en: TAKA: Ah, right, well, uh...
ja: タカ: あ、うん、その、えっと…

key: TAKA: Um, hi there, Mrs. Molinar.
en: TAKA: Um, hi there, Mrs. Molinar.
ja: タカ: あの、こんにちは、モリナーさん。

key: This is \PN, and my name is Taka.
en: This is \PN, and my name is Taka.
ja: こちらは\PN、俺の名前はタカです。

key: The uh, 'funky onion', is a Pokémon that can sort of... travel through time.
en: The uh, 'funky onion', is a Pokémon that can sort of...  travel through time.
ja: その、『変な玉ねぎ』は、その…時を渡ることができるポケモンなんです。

key: We're from the future-- but it's not strong enough to make it back there in one jump.
en: We're from the future-- but it's not strong enough to make it back there in one jump.
ja: 俺たちは未来から来ました――でも、一気に戻るほどの力はまだなくて。

key: So we just need to wait a bit while it recovers enough energy to take us home.
en: So we just need to wait a bit while it recovers enough energy to take us home.
ja: だから、俺たちを連れ帰れるだけのエネルギーが回復するまで、少し待つ必要があるんです。

key: We can just hang out over here; we'll try not to disturb you?
en: We can just hang out over here; we'll try not to disturb you?
ja: こっちで大人しくしてますから、邪魔しないようにします?

key: ELENA: ...You expect me to believe that the onion is some kind of time travel Pokémon?
en: ELENA: ...You expect me to believe that the onion is some kind of time travel Pokémon?
ja: エレナ: …その玉ねぎが何かの時渡りポケモンだって、あたしに信じろって言うの?

key: I've never heard of a Water Type that can do anything like that.
en: I've never heard of a Water Type that can do anything like that.
ja: そんなことができるみずタイプなんて聞いたことないわ。

key: TAKA: I, uh, don't think it's a Water Type.
en: TAKA: I, uh, don't think it's a Water Type.
ja: タカ: え、あの、たぶんみずタイプじゃないと思います。

key: ELENA: It is literally dripping wet.
en: ELENA: It is literally dripping wet.
ja: エレナ: だってびしょぬれじゃない。

key: Either that is a Water Type, or somebody has dumped two or three bottles of water on it.
en: Either that is a Water Type, or somebody has dumped two or three bottles of water on it.
ja: それがみずタイプか、誰かがボトル2、3本分の水をかけたかのどっちかね。

key: TAKA: ...
en: TAKA: ...
ja: タカ: …

key: ELENA: ...
en: ELENA: ...
ja: エレナ: …
\PN: …

key: CELEBI: Biiii~
en: CELEBI: Biiii~
ja: セレビィ: ビィー~

key: ELENA: All right, fine, if you're really from the future, how far?
en: ELENA: All right, fine, if you're really from the future, how far?
ja: エレナ: わかった、いいわ、本当に未来から来たっていうなら、どれくらい先?

key: TAKA: Um, maybe around 15 years, give or take a bit?
en: TAKA: Um, maybe around 15 years, give or take a bit?
ja: タカ: えっと、だいたい15年くらい、前後するかもですけど?

key: ELENA: Fine, fine. If you're from the future, then tell me...
en: ELENA: Fine, fine. If you're from the future, then tell me...
ja: エレナ: いいわ、いいわ。未来から来たっていうなら、教えて…

key: Oh!
en: Oh!
ja: あ!

key: What's the Byxbysion Ward like?
en: What's the Byxbysion Ward like?
ja: ビクスビジョンワードってどんな感じ?

key: They just drew up plans to incorporate that area into the city.
en: They just drew up plans to incorporate that area into the city.
ja: ちょうどあのエリアを市に編入する計画が立てられたところなの。

key: They want it to be super swanky, luxury apartments and that whole deal.
en: They want it to be super swanky, luxury apartments and that whole deal.
ja: 超高級なマンションとか、そういうのを作りたいらしいわよ。

key: How'd that turn out?
en: How'd that turn out?
ja: 結局どうなったの?

key: TAKA: I, uh, I'm not sure we should tell--
en: TAKA: I, uh, I'm not sure we should tell--
ja: タカ: あの、その、言っていいものか――

key: ELENA: Oh, oh, I know! What about the Tourmaline Trainline?
en: ELENA: Oh, oh, I know! What about the Tourmaline Trainline?
ja: エレナ: あ、そうだ、わかった! トルマリン線はどう?

key: Does it still have its reputation for 24/7 service, always on time?
en: Does it still have its reputation for 24/7 service, always on time?
ja: 24時間365日、常に時間通りっていう評判は、まだ健在?

key: TAKA: I really don't think--
en: TAKA: I really don't think--
ja: タカ: 本当に、それは――

key: ELENA: Oh, how about Calcenon and Labradorra, who are the Gym Leaders?
en: ELENA: Oh, how about Calcenon and Labradorra, who are the Gym Leaders?
ja: エレナ: あ、カルセノンとラブラドラのジムリーダーは誰?

key: I know Caroline and Monty want their daughters to succeed them, but knowing those two,
en: I know Caroline and Monty want their daughters to succeed them, but knowing those two,
ja: キャロラインとモンティが娘に後を継がせたがってるのは知ってるけど、あの二人のことだから、

key: They'll probably cling onto their titles until one of the kids can actually beat them!
en: They'll probably cling onto their titles until one of the kids can actually beat them!
ja: 娘のどっちかが実際に自分を倒せるようになるまで、しがみついて肩書きを離さないでしょうね!

key: TAKA: Oh, uh, actually--
en: TAKA: Oh, uh, actually--
ja: タカ: あ、えっと、実は――

key: ELENA: Okay, last question. Who is the Champion?
en: ELENA: Okay, last question. Who is the Champion?
ja: エレナ: よし、最後の質問。チャンピオンは誰?

key: TAKA: Oh, umm, well that's uh...
en: TAKA: Oh, umm, well that's uh...
ja: タカ: あ、えっと、それはその…

key: That's actually \PN.
en: That's actually \PN.
ja: 実は、\PNなんです。

key: ELENA: Bullshit it is!
en: ELENA: Bullshit it is!
ja: エレナ: たわ言なんかじゃないわね!

key: Hey, show me your trainer card!
en: Hey, show me your trainer card!
ja: ねえ、トレーナーカード見せて!

key: Elena snatches your trainer card away from you before you can react.
en: Elena snatches your trainer card away from you before you can react.
ja: エレナは反応する間もなく、あなたのトレーナーカードをひったくった。

key: ELENA: Huh. The date on here...
en: ELENA: Huh. The date on here...
ja: エレナ: あら。この日付…

key: And I mean, that's 18 badges, even though I don't recognize most of them.
en: And I mean, that's 18 badges, even though I don't recognize most of them.
ja: しかも、バッジ18個って、ほとんど見覚えないんだけど。

key: You really are the future Champion? That's pretty wild.
en: You really are the future Champion? That's pretty wild.
ja: 本当に未来のチャンピオンなの? かなりぶっ飛んでるわね。

key: Here's your trainer card back; sorry about that.
en: Here's your trainer card back; sorry about that.
ja: トレーナーカード返すわ、悪かったわね。

key: TAKA: So, I guess you believe us now...?
en: TAKA: So, I guess you believe us now...?
ja: タカ: じゃあ、もう信じてくれた…?

key: ELENA: I mean, I've seen weirder things.
en: ELENA: I mean, I've seen weirder things.
ja: エレナ: まあ、もっと変なもの見たことあるし。

key: Try to think about how the geography of any of these Elite Four rooms works for like ten seconds.
en: Try to think about how the geography of any of these Elite Four rooms works for like ten seconds.
ja: この四天王の部屋、どういう地理で成り立ってるか10秒くらい考えてみなさいよ。

key: TAKA: Uh... I guess... Magnets?
en: TAKA: Uh... I guess... Magnets?
ja: タカ: えっと…たぶん…磁石?

key: ELENA: Ha!
en: ELENA: Ha!
ja: エレナ: ハッ!

key: I like you, kid.
en: I like you, kid.
ja: 気に入ったわ、坊や。

key: Now, here's the thing. I COULD just let you chill out while you wait for the onion to get its strength back.
en: Now, here's the thing. I COULD just let you chill out while you wait for the onion to get its strength back.
ja: それでね、こういうことよ。玉ねぎが力を取り戻すまでのんびりさせてあげてもいいんだけど。

key: But, as I'm sure you are very well aware,
en: But, as I'm sure you are very well aware,
ja: でも、よくわかってると思うけど、

key: I don't plan to retire until I'm an old hag.
en: I don't plan to retire until I'm an old hag.
ja: あたしはおばあちゃんになるまで引退するつもりないの。

key: If you're the Champion in the future, you've beaten me in battle once before.
en: If you're the Champion in the future, you've beaten me in battle once before.
ja: 未来であんたがチャンピオンだっていうなら、前に一度あたしをバトルで倒したってことよね。

key: And I have a responsibility to make sure I've not gone soft in the future.
en: And I have a responsibility to make sure I've not gone soft in the future.
ja: だから、未来のあたしが甘くなってないか確かめる責任があるわ。

key: Talk to me when you're ready to lose, Champion!
en: Talk to me when you're ready to lose, Champion!
ja: 負ける覚悟ができたら話しかけて、チャンピオン!

key: TAKA: She's pretty... intense.
en: TAKA: She's pretty... intense.
ja: タカ: すごい…迫力だな。

key: I know we can't tell her but...
en: I know we can't tell her but...
ja: 教えられないのはわかってるけど…

key: It's just sad.
en: It's just sad.
ja: ただ悲しいな。

key: ELIAS: Huh, this isn't my room. But why...
en: ELIAS: Huh, this isn't my room. But why...
ja: イライアス: おや、これは私の部屋ではありませんね。しかしなぜ…

key: ELIAS: Ah.
en: ELIAS: Ah.
ja: イライアス: ああ。

key: We are closer to our time, but I believe we are still in the past.
en: We are closer to our time, but I believe we are still in the past.
ja: 我々の時代に近づいてはいますが、まだ過去にいるようです。

key: This room must look familiar to you-- a perfect match to Heather's.
en: This room must look familiar to you-- a perfect match to Heather's.
ja: この部屋、あなたには見覚えがあるでしょう――ヘザーの部屋とそっくりですから。

key: But notice that this is the third chamber, not the first.
en: But notice that this is the third chamber, not the first.
ja: ですが、これは第1の間ではなく、第3の間だということにお気づきでしょう。

key: I believe this chamber belongs to her mother, who I was on the Elite Four with many years ago, before she...
en: I believe this chamber belongs to her mother, who I was on the Elite Four with many years ago, before she...
ja: この間は彼女の母君のもの、私が何年も前に四天王として共にいた方の…その方が…

key: ELIAS: Well. Let's just hope she's not in.
en: ELIAS: Well. Let's just hope she's not in.
ja: イライアス: まあ。留守であることを祈りましょう。

key: She can be... a lot.
en: She can be... a lot.
ja: あの方は…その、かなり強烈なので。

key: ???: Wait, fuck, nobody told me we had challengers today!
en: ???: Wait, fuck, nobody told me we had challengers today!
ja: ???: ちょ、くそ、今日挑戦者が来るなんて誰も教えてくれなかったんだけど!

key: ELIAS: We should probably stand back.
en: ELIAS: We should probably stand back.
ja: イライアス: 下がっておいた方がよさそうですね。

key: ???: ...Well shit, I actually made the jump.
en: ???: ...Well shit, I actually made the jump.
ja: ???: …あら、まさか本当に飛び移れるとはね。

key: ELENA: ...Elias, you could have said it was just you.
en: ELENA: ...Elias, you could have said it was just you.
ja: エレナ: …イライアス、あんただけだって言ってくれれば良かったのに。

key: I did a whole entrance!
en: I did a whole entrance!
ja: せっかく登場演出までしたのに!

key: ELIAS: Indeed; and as per usual, your entrance was as impressive as it was reckless.
en: ELIAS: Indeed; and as per usual, your entrance was as impressive as it was reckless.
ja: イライアス: 確かに。そして相変わらず、その登場は見事であると同時に無謀でしたね。

key: ELENA: Wait, what the hell happened to you, Elias!?
en: ELENA: Wait, what the hell happened to you, Elias!?
ja: エレナ: ちょっと、イライアス、一体何があったのよ?!

key: You look like shit!
en: You look like shit!
ja: ひどい顔よ!

key: Did you age like, 20 years since yesterday?
en: Did you age like, 20 years since yesterday?
ja: 昨日から20歳くらい老けたんじゃない?

key: ELIAS: I... don't think it can have been much more than 15 years.
en: ELIAS: I... don't think it can have been much more than 15 years.
ja: イライアス: いえ…15年程度のはずですが。

key: ELENA: Well, I was just being polite.
en: ELENA: Well, I was just being polite.
ja: エレナ: まあ、あたしは気を遣ってあげただけよ。

key: It looks like it's been 25.
en: It looks like it's been 25.
ja: 見た目じゃ25年って感じ。

key: ELIAS: Of course...
en: ELIAS: Of course...
ja: イライアス: なるほど…

key: As usual, your particular brand of politeness is quite... refreshing.
en: As usual, your particular brand of politeness is quite... refreshing.
ja: 相変わらず、あなた独特の気遣いは、実に…爽やかですね。

key: ELENA: Sorry, old man. As much as you love how nice I am to you, I'm spoken for.
en: ELENA: Sorry, old man. As much as you love how nice I am to you, I'm spoken for.
ja: エレナ: 悪いわね、おじいちゃん。あたしの優しさがどんなに好きでも、あたしには相手がいるの。

key: But whatever. All joking aside, why do you look so old?
en: But whatever. All joking aside, why do you look so old?
ja: まあいいわ。冗談は置いといて、なんでそんなに老けて見えるの?

key: And who's the stranger and the Pokémon?
en: And who's the stranger and the Pokémon?
ja: それで、その見知らぬ子とポケモンは誰?

key: ELIAS: This is a Legendary time-traveling Pokémon.
en: ELIAS: This is a Legendary time-traveling Pokémon.
ja: イライアス: これは時を渡る伝説のポケモンです。

key: We're from... I'd say somewhere between 10 and 15 years in the future.
en: We're from... I'd say somewhere between 10 and 15 years in the future.
ja: 私たちは…そうですね、10年から15年ほど未来から来ています。

key: ELENA: Huh.
en: ELENA: Huh.
ja: エレナ: ふーん。

key: Well, I hope I look better as an old bag than you do.
en: Well, I hope I look better as an old bag than you do.
ja: まあ、あんたよりはあたしの方がババアになってもましに見えることを願うわ。

key: Though I suppose I have the type advantage there; Ghosts have a pretty strong monopoly on cool old ladies.
en: Though I suppose I have the type advantage there; Ghosts have a pretty strong monopoly on cool old ladies.
ja: とはいえ、そこはタイプ的に有利かもね。ゴーストってかっこいいおばあちゃんをほぼ独占してるし。

key: ELIAS: Elena, you...
en: ELIAS: Elena, you...
ja: イライアス: エレナ、あなたは…

key: Well, I said 15 years, not 50. You're still quite young.
en: Well, I said 15 years, not 50. You're still quite young.
ja: まあ、15年と言ったのであって、50年とは言っていません。まだ十分お若いですよ。

key: ELENA: Oh my.
en: ELENA: Oh my.
ja: エレナ: あら、まあ。

key: Did I, lowly Elena, get a compliment from Mister High and Mighty Elias himself?
en: Did I, lowly Elena, get a compliment from Mister High and Mighty Elias himself?
ja: この卑しいエレナが、偉大なるイライアス様ご本人から褒め言葉をいただいたわけ?

key: You must have gone soft in your old age!
en: You must have gone soft in your old age!
ja: 年取って丸くなったんじゃない!

key: I am not worthy, oh great one!
en: I am not worthy, oh great one!
ja: 身に余る光栄でございます、偉大なるお方!

key: Asinus asinum fricat.
en: Asinus asinum fricat.
ja: アシヌス・アシヌム・フリカト。

key: ELIAS: Where did you learn the ancient--
en: ELIAS: Where did you learn the ancient--
ja: イライアス: どこでその古語を学んで――

key: ELENA: Stole one of your books.
en: ELENA: Stole one of your books.
ja: エレナ: あんたの本を一冊くすねたのよ。

key: Anyway, who's the stranger?
en: Anyway, who's the stranger?
ja: それで、その見知らぬ子は誰?

key: A new member of the Elite Four in the future?
en: A new member of the Elite Four in the future?
ja: 未来の新しい四天王メンバー?

key: Did you make a second friend?
en: Did you make a second friend?
ja: 二人目の友達ができたの?

key: I'm so proud of you!
en: I'm so proud of you!
ja: 本当に誇らしいわ!

key: It was getting exhausting inviting you to dinner with me and my husband every weekend.
en: It was getting exhausting inviting you to dinner with me and my husband every weekend.
ja: 毎週末あんたを夫との夕食に誘うのも、正直疲れてきてたのよね。

key: But I was just so worried you'd be on your own otherwise.
en: But I was just so worried you'd be on your own otherwise.
ja: でも、そうしないとあんたが一人ぼっちになるんじゃないかって、心配で仕方なかったの。

key: ELIAS: Elena.
en: ELIAS: Elena.
ja: イライアス: エレナ。

key: You and I are work acquaintances.
en: You and I are work acquaintances.
ja: あなたと私は仕事上の知り合いです。

key: I assure you, my social life is fine.
en: I assure you, my social life is fine.
ja: 断言しますが、私の社交生活は問題ありません。

key: That is why I continually turn down your invitations.
en: That is why I continually turn down your invitations.
ja: だからこそ、あなたの誘いをずっと断り続けているのです。

key: Anyway, no. \PN here is not a member of the Elite Four.
en: Anyway, no. \PN here is not a member of the Elite Four.
ja: とにかく、いいえ。ここにいる\PNは四天王ではありません。

key: He is the Champion.
en: He is the Champion.
ja: 彼はチャンピオンです。

key: She is the Champion.
en: She is the Champion.
ja: 彼女はチャンピオンです。

key: They are the Champion.
en: They are the Champion.
ja: この方はチャンピオンです。

key: ELENA: The Champion, you say?
en: ELENA: The Champion, you say?
ja: エレナ: チャンピオン、ですって?

key: ELENA: Hey. Champion.
en: ELENA: Hey. Champion.
ja: エレナ: ねえ。チャンピオン。

key: Wanna battle?
en: Wanna battle?
ja: バトルする?

key: ELIAS: Elena, I don't think that--
en: ELIAS: Elena, I don't think that--
ja: イライアス: エレナ、それは――

key: ELENA: Yeah, yeah, I know; he's already beaten me once.
en: ELENA: Yeah, yeah, I know; he's already beaten me once.
ja: エレナ: はいはい、わかってる。彼にはもう一回負けてるんでしょ。

key: ELENA: Yeah, yeah, I know; she's already beaten me once.
en: ELENA: Yeah, yeah, I know; she's already beaten me once.
ja: エレナ: はいはい、わかってる。彼女にはもう一回負けてるんでしょ。

key: ELENA: Yeah, yeah, I know; they've already beaten me once.
en: ELENA: Yeah, yeah, I know; they've already beaten me once.
ja: エレナ: はいはい、わかってる。この人にはもう一回負けてるんでしょ。

key: But you put a strong trainer in front of me, so now I've got the itch to fight!
en: But you put a strong trainer in front of me, so now I've got the itch to fight!
ja: でも強いトレーナーを目の前に出されたら、うずうずしちゃうのよね!

key: And what, do you wanna give me a try instead?
en: And what, do you wanna give me a try instead?
ja: それとも何、あんたが代わりに挑んでみる?

key: Do you think a few years have put you on my level?
en: Do you think a few years have put you on my level?
ja: 数年経てば、あたしのレベルに追いつけると思う?

key: ELIAS: I...
en: ELIAS: I...
ja: イライアス: 私は…

key: ELIAS: Not on this field.
en: ELIAS: Not on this field.
ja: イライアス: この分野ではとても。

key: ELENA: Didn't think so.
en: ELENA: Didn't think so.
ja: エレナ: だと思った。

key: Now it's nothing personal or anything, but I need to make sure I've not gone soft in the future.
en: Now it's nothing personal or anything, but I need to make sure I've not gone soft in the future.
ja: 別に個人的な話じゃないけど、未来のあたしが甘くなってないか確かめなきゃいけないから。

key: So talk to me when you're ready to lose, Champion!
en: So talk to me when you're ready to lose, Champion!
ja: 負ける覚悟ができたら話しかけて、チャンピオン!

key: ELIAS: I always found her infuriating.
en: ELIAS: I always found her infuriating.
ja: イライアス: 彼女には、いつも腹が立たされてきました。

key: But... I miss her.
en: But... I miss her.
ja: ですが…恋しく思います。

key: I saw what Sirius was doing to Meteor, but I couldn't...
en: I saw what Sirius was doing to Meteor, but I couldn't...
ja: シリウスがメテオに何をしていたか、私は見ていました。しかし私は…

key: No; I DIDN'T stop him.
en: No; I DIDN'T stop him.
ja: いえ、私は彼を止めませんでした。

key: Sirius was a poison, claiming radical action could help us achieve the Order's goals.
en: Sirius was a poison, claiming radical action could help us achieve the Order's goals.
ja: シリウスは毒でした。急進的な行動こそが教団の目標達成に役立つと主張していた。

key: Maybe that was the right course of action?
en: Maybe that was the right course of action?
ja: それが正しい行動だったのかもしれません。

key: But it was doomed to fail.
en: But it was doomed to fail.
ja: しかし、それは失敗する運命にあった。

key: Because Sirius cared nothing for the Order's goals.
en: Because Sirius cared nothing for the Order's goals.
ja: なぜなら、シリウスは教団の目標など何とも思っていなかったからです。

key: He just wanted to make history.
en: He just wanted to make history.
ja: 彼はただ、歴史に名を刻みたかっただけだった。

key: Perhaps if I had stopped him...
en: Perhaps if I had stopped him...
ja: もし私が彼を止めていたら…

key: If I had tried to convince the others of his selfish motivations...
en: If I had tried to convince the others of his selfish motivations...
ja: 彼の身勝手な動機を、他の者たちに説得しようとしていたら…

key: Perhaps then Lin would never have been able to gain the influence she did.
en: Perhaps then Lin would never have been able to gain the influence she did.
ja: リンがあれほどの影響力を得ることは、決してなかったかもしれません。

key: Perhaps then Elena would still be...
en: Perhaps then Elena would still be...
ja: そうすれば、エレナも今頃まだ…

key: Perhaps then Phoenix would still be...
en: Perhaps then Phoenix would still be...
ja: そうすれば、フェニックスも今頃まだ…

key: ELIAS: ...Watch yourself in your battle, my Lord.
en: ELIAS: ...Watch yourself in your battle, my Lord.
ja: イライアス: …バトルではお気をつけて、我が主。

key: She was one of the most formidable trainers I've ever known.
en: She was one of the most formidable trainers I've ever known.
ja: 彼女は、私が知る中でも最も手強いトレーナーの一人でした。

key: HEATHER: Another 2-for-1?
en: HEATHER: Another 2-for-1?
ja: ヘザー: また二人一組?

key: Geez, \PN, I thought it might get lonely all the way back in the Champion room, but I didn't expect you to make it a tourist destination!
en: Geez, \PN, I thought it might get lonely all the way back in the Champion room, but I didn't expect you to make it a tourist destination!
ja: まったく、\PN、チャンピオンルームまで戻って寂しいかもって思ってたけど、まさか観光地にするとは思わなかったよ!

key: SHELLY: Nah, you've got the wrong idea.
en: SHELLY: Nah, you've got the wrong idea.
ja: シェリー: いや、それ違うから。

key: I'm not here with him.
en: I'm not here with him.
ja: 彼と一緒に来たんじゃないの。

key: He's here with me!
en: He's here with me!
ja: 彼があたしについてきたの!

key: I'm not here with her.
en: I'm not here with her.
ja: 彼女と一緒に来たんじゃないの。

key: She's here with me!
en: She's here with me!
ja: 彼女があたしについてきたの!

key: I'm not here with them.
en: I'm not here with them.
ja: この人と一緒に来たんじゃないの。

key: They're here with me!
en: They're here with me!
ja: この人があたしについてきたの!

key: I wanted to show \PN how far I've come since last time!
en: I wanted to show \PN how far I've come since last time!
ja: \PNに、前よりどれだけ成長したか見せたかったの!

key: And I decided the best way to do that is by taking on all the other Leaders myself!
en: And I decided the best way to do that is by taking on all the other Leaders myself!
ja: それで、一番いい方法は自分一人で他のリーダー全員に挑むことだって決めたの!

key: Obviously, this is just a practice match, since I haven't fought my way up yet...
en: Obviously, this is just a practice match, since I haven't fought my way up yet...
ja: もちろん、まだ正式に勝ち上がってきたわけじゃないから、これは練習試合なんだけど…

key: But you and \PN are both my friends, so we can just do that, right?
en: But you and \PN are both my friends, so we can just do that, right?
ja: でも、あんたも\PNも友達だから、これくらいいいよね?

key: HEATHER: I don't see why not,
en: HEATHER: I don't see why not,
ja: ヘザー: 別にいいけど、

key: If you're really that desperate to lose, I'm always happy to give you a go for it!
en: If you're really that desperate to lose, I'm always happy to give you a go for it!
ja: そんなに負けたいなら、いつでも喜んで付き合ってあげる!

key: SHELLY: You know, Heather, that's what I like about you.
en: SHELLY: You know, Heather, that's what I like about you.
ja: シェリー: ねえヘザー、そういうところ好きよ。

key: You're always so confident and full of energy,
en: You're always so confident and full of energy,
ja: いつも自信満々で元気いっぱいで、

key: Even right before your world gets totally turned upside down!
en: Even right before your world gets totally turned upside down!
ja: 世界がひっくり返る直前だっていうのに!

key: HEATHER: Oh???
en: HEATHER: Oh???
ja: ヘザー: あら???

key: Are you actually trying to trash-talk me?
en: Are you actually trying to trash-talk me?
ja: 本気であたしに挑発してるつもり?

key: Is little Shell Bell finally learning to have an attitude!?
en: Is little Shell Bell finally learning to have an attitude!?
ja: ちっちゃいシェルベルもついに生意気になってきたわけ!?

key: SHELLY: Er, no-- No, I wasn't trying to--
en: SHELLY: Er, no-- No, I wasn't trying to--
ja: シェリー: え、いや――違うの、そんなつもりじゃ――

key: Be rude or anything...
en: Be rude or anything...
ja: 失礼なことしようとか、そういうんじゃなくて…

key: HEATHER: Hey!
en: HEATHER: Hey!
ja: ヘザー: ちょっと!

key: You started this; don't shrivel up now!
en: You started this; don't shrivel up now!
ja: 自分から始めといて、今さら縮こまらないでよ!

key: I never said I was mad or anything!
en: I never said I was mad or anything!
ja: 怒ってるなんて一言も言ってないし!

key: On the contrary, I can't wait for you to put your mouth where your money is!
en: On the contrary, I can't wait for you to put your mouth where your money is!
ja: むしろ、有言実行するあんたを見るのが待ちきれない!

key: If you're gonna give it your all anyway, you may as well, right?!
en: If you're gonna give it your all anyway, you may as well, right?!
ja: どうせ全力でやるつもりなら、それでいいじゃない?!

key: It's more fun that way anyway, isn't it?!
en: It's more fun that way anyway, isn't it?!
ja: その方が絶対楽しいでしょ?!

key: SHELLY: All right, fine-- you asked for it!
en: SHELLY: All right, fine-- you asked for it!
ja: シェリー: わかった、いいわ――自分で望んだんだからね!

key: If that's really the way you feel, then I have no choice but to punt you straight into the New World!
en: If that's really the way you feel, then I have no choice but to punt you straight into the New World!
ja: 本気でそう思ってるなら、あんたを新世界まで蹴飛ばしてやるしかないわね!

key: HEATHER: That's the spirit!
en: HEATHER: That's the spirit!
ja: ヘザー: それでこそ!

key: Bring it on-- I'll squash you like your own type!
en: Bring it on-- I'll squash you like your own type!
ja: かかってきなさい――あんたのタイプみたいにたたき潰してやる!

key: SHELLY: Let's go, Heather! It's take-down time!
en: SHELLY: Let's go, Heather! It's take-down time!
ja: シェリー: 行くわよ、ヘザー! とっしんの時間!

key: HEATHER: Please, Yanmega doesn't even learn Take Down!
en: HEATHER: Please, Yanmega doesn't even learn Take Down!
ja: ヘザー: はぁ、メガヤンマってとっしん覚えないから!

key: SHELLY: Who said I was talking to my Yanmega?
en: SHELLY: Who said I was talking to my Yanmega?
ja: シェリー: 誰がメガヤンマに言ったなんて言った?

key: Don't forget, you're talking to the girl who's gonna be the best Trainer in the world someday!
en: Don't forget, you're talking to the girl who's gonna be the best Trainer in the world someday!
ja: 忘れないで、あんたが話してるのは、いつか世界一のトレーナーになる女の子なんだから!

key: HEATHER: Back again, huh?
en: HEATHER: Back again, huh?
ja: ヘザー: また戻ってきたんだ?

key: Well, you know the drill!
en: Well, you know the drill!
ja: まあ、いつも通りだよね!

key: I'm not gonna go down so easily!
en: I'm not gonna go down so easily!
ja: そう簡単には負けないから!

key: Think you can rise to my level?!
en: Think you can rise to my level?!
ja: あたしのレベルまで上がってこられると思う?!

key: I have total control! Total freedom!
en: I have total control! Total freedom!
ja: 完全なコントロール! 完全な自由!

key: I'll never let anyone beat me down!
en: I'll never let anyone beat me down!
ja: 誰にも打ちのめされたりしない!

key: Salamence, it's take-off time!
en: Salamence, it's take-off time!
ja: ボーマンダ、離陸の時間!

key: HEATHER: HEY!
en: HEATHER: HEY!
ja: ヘザー: ちょっと!

key: I was wondering when you were gonna show up already. Geez!
en: I was wondering when you were gonna show up already. Geez!
ja: いつ来るんだろうって思ってたよ、もう!

key: You have any idea how long I've been waiting up here?
en: You have any idea how long I've been waiting up here?
ja: ここでどれだけ待ってたと思ってるの?

key: I'll give you a hint-- it's almost forever.
en: I'll give you a hint-- it's almost forever.
ja: ヒントあげる――永遠に近いくらい。

key: Anna said I had to be here for something "soon" but then it still took so long!
en: Anna said I had to be here for something "soon" but then it still took so long!
ja: アンナに『もうすぐ』何かのためにここにいなきゃって言われたのに、結局すごく時間かかったし!

key: ...Anyway,
en: ...Anyway,
ja: …とにかく、

key: Uh...
en: Uh...
ja: えっと…

key: To tell the truth, there's something I've been wanting to say to you.
en: To tell the truth, there's something I've been wanting to say to you.
ja: 正直に言うと、ずっとあなたに言いたかったことがあるの。

key: I know I've been, well, kind of a brat.
en: I know I've been, well, kind of a brat.
ja: 自分がその、ちょっとわがままだったのはわかってる。

key: But even despite that, you were there to help out in Ametrine,
en: But even despite that, you were there to help out in Ametrine,
ja: それでもあなたはアメトリンで助けに来てくれたし、

key: And even though I didn't really understand what was going on at the time, you were there at the doctor's place too...
en: And even though I didn't really understand what was going on at the time, you were there at the doctor's place too...
ja: あの時何が起きてるのかよくわかってなかったけど、あの医者のところにもあなたはいてくれた…

key: You and Shelly have always done your best for me, even though I never deserved it.
en: You and Shelly have always done your best for me, even though I never deserved it.
ja: あなたとシェリーはいつも精一杯やってくれた、わたしにそんな価値なんてなかったのに。

key: I'm not really used to people being nice to me.
en: I'm not really used to people being nice to me.
ja: 人に優しくされるのに、あんまり慣れてないんだ。

key: I mean, you saw what my dad was like.
en: I mean, you saw what my dad was like.
ja: だって、うちの父親がどんな感じだったか見たでしょ。

key: And I ended up finding an old journal of his.
en: And I ended up finding an old journal of his.
ja: それで、父の古い日記を見つけたの。

key: I guess in his own weird, roundabout way he was just trying to look out for me.
en: I guess in his own weird, roundabout way he was just trying to look out for me.
ja: 自分なりの、変で回りくどいやり方だったけど、あの人はただわたしを気にかけようとしてたんだと思う。

key: It's a lot to take in, but I think I understand.
en: It's a lot to take in, but I think I understand.
